What will you do
As our new Reach Truck Driver, your day is full of action, variety, and driving! You will spend a big part of your day cruising through the warehouse, storing goods and returns in the right racks with your reach truck. Together with your team, you keep the warehouse flow moving by safely unloading incoming trucks and preparing outgoing shipments. You also check documents, pick lists, and sign them off. To keep things varied, you will also jump on the EPT from time to time. Finally, you will carry out inventory counts and perform physical tasks like restacking heavy goods up to 15 kg.
